HIRING - Recruitment Intern by Sholapedebbie(op): 8:16am
JOB TITLE: Recruitment Intern

LOCATION: Lagos, Abuja, Enugu, Kaduna, Kano, or Delta (Nigeria)

WORK MODE: Fully Remote

BENEFITS: Performance-based stipends, data allowance, practical HR/talent acquisition training, official internship certificate, and potential for full-time conversion.

ABOUT THE ROLE

FMR Agency is hiring proactive, detail-oriented Recruitment Interns in Lagos, Abuja, Enugu, Kaduna, Kano, and Delta to support end-to-end hiring pipelines across Nigeria.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Candidate Sourcing: Identify top talent via LinkedIn, social media, job boards, and niche databases.

CV Screening: Evaluate applications against role frameworks for qualifications and suitability.

Talent Shortlisting: Compile and organize qualified candidates for hiring manager review.

REQUIREMENTS & QUALIFICATIONS

Experience: Prior entry-level experience or hands-on exposure (internship, NYSC, volunteering, or admin support) in HR, Talent Acquisition, or Recruitment.

Location: Must reside in Lagos, Abuja, Enugu, Kaduna, Kano, or Delta State with reliable internet.

Education: B.Sc., B.A., or HND in HRM, Business Administration, Social Sciences, or a related field.

Skills: Strong CV evaluation skills, excellent written/verbal communication, basic Microsoft Office (Word, Excel), and self-motivation to hit remote targets.

HOW TO APPLY
Send your updated CV to recruiter@fmragency.example with "Recruitment Intern – [Your State]" as the email subject line (e.g., Recruitment Intern – Abuja).
